title: Decision Models as Retrieval Gates Against Injection and Pollution
abstract: arXiv:2611.08325v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieved web text can carry instructions aimed at the language model, or synthetic pages written to mislead. We test whether released open-weight decision models, which answer typed questions about a text without generating tokens, can screen retrieved passages against both threats. On a benchmark of 1,000 questions over forum-style web pages with hidden injected instructions, a Kev-4B gate reads each passage's HTML. Attack success, measured automatically, falls from 27.9% with no defence to 13.6% with the published mitigations (sanitisation, normalisation and citation prompting) and to 5.7% with the gate added. The gate takes 76 ms per passage and wrongly flags 4 of 186 benign pages with instructions for human readers. Responsiveness on clean queries stays within a point (85.6% to 86.2%). On a 200-query pollution testbed where two thirds of the candidate pages are fake, filtering the pool before the top ten are chosen keeps fake page

translated_title: 决策模型作为抵御注入与污染的检索闸门
translated_abstract: 检索到的网页文本可能携带针对语言模型的恶意指令，或是旨在误导模型的合成页面。我们测试了已发布的开放权重决策模型——这类模型针对文本回答指定类型的问题而不生成任何 token——能否作为筛选检索段落的闸门，同时抵御这两类威胁。在一个包含 1,000 个问题、基于带有隐藏注入指令的论坛式网页的基准测试中，一个 Kev-4B 闸门读取每个段落的 HTML。攻击成功率（自动测量）从无防御时的 27.9% 降至采用已发布缓解措施（净化、规范化和引用提示）后的 13.6%，再加入闸门后进一步降至 5.7%。该闸门处理每个段落仅需 76 毫秒，并且在 186 个包含面向人类读者指令的良性页面中仅错误标记 4 个。对干净查询的响应率保持在 1 个百分点以内（85.6% 至 86.2%）。在一个包含 200 个查询的污染测试平台中（其中三分之二的候选页面为伪造页面），在选出前十条结果之前对候选池进行过滤可保持伪造页面……（摘要至此截断）
tldr: 开放权重决策模型可作为检索闸门，在不生成任何文本的情况下以极低成本（每段 76 毫秒）过滤检索内容中的隐藏提示注入指令与伪造污染页面，将攻击成功率从 27.9% 降至 5.7%，且对正常问答的响应率几乎没有影响。
en_tdlr: Open-weight decision models can serve as retrieval gates that screen out hidden prompt injections and synthetic pollution pages without generating any text, at minimal cost (76 ms per passage), cutting attack success from 27.9% to 5.7% with negligible impact on clean-query responsiveness.
